text:
sasha: We got a DSAR asking for deletion of chat transcripts and uploaded files for user id=redacted123. Those items are present in nightly encrypted snapshots in s3://redwood-backups/2026/ and encrypted with retired key alias redwood-backup-v1 (scheduled decommission).
sasha: Legal just flagged an active vuln triage that references the same account. Need clarity: retention exception vs deletion timeline before we act.
mike: Quick question  are those backups immutable (versioned + write-once)? If yes, deleting live copies won't remove snapshots.
mike: Rewrap is possible but today we only have a manual flow that needs old-key access. Automating rewrap would be a separate change.
ada: @sasha if there's an active investigation, Legal recommends placing an immediate hold. That supersedes DSAR deletion until the hold is lifted.
ada: Please open a retention-exception ticket and link the vuln triage. Include requester identity verification artifacts and chain-of-custody notes for future forensics.
ops-oncall: Steps to apply hold (ops):
ops-oncall: 1) mark account in retention DB: retention.holds.add(redacted123, reason=\"vuln-triage\")
ops-oncall: 2) tag snapshots: aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket redwood-backups --key 2026-03-15/snap-... --tagging 'Hold=VULN_TRIAGE'
ops-oncall: 3) create internal ticket and enforce SLO to block deletions on objects with Hold=VULN_TRIAGE
mike: RBAC note: rewrap and snapshot-read ops should be narrowed. Currently role backup-operator can rewrap; propose: allow kms:ReEncrypt + s3:GetObject for backup keys only when backup-operator AND legal-priv both approve.
mike: Also add an audit rule to capture kms:Decrypt / kms:ReEncrypt calls against backup keys; include principal, request-id, and ticket id.
sasha: If Legal requests hold, can we still perform data minimization on live systems? I'd prefer scrubbing PII from live DB immediately to reduce exposure while preserving backups intact.
ops-oncall: Yes. We can redact live data now. Proposed quick script (run in maintenance window):
ops-oncall: ```
# pseudo
UPDATE messages SET content = '[REDACTED] (redacted per DSAR, id=redacted123)' WHERE user_id='redacted123';
``` 
ops-oncall: Log the admin user, timestamp, and commit sha for audit.
mike: For audit logging, ensure the redaction is written to audit index with fields: actor, change_hash, ticket_id, before_snapshot_ref.
ada: Legal action: continue identity verification. If verification fails  do not delete. If it passes and vuln triage resolves with no hold, follow standard DSAR erase playbook and produce the audit package.
sasha: We also need messaging for support so users see the DSAR is being processed but held. Any wording suggestions?
mike: Suggested support note (keep high-level): \"We received your deletion request and have temporarily preserved backups due to an ongoing security investigation. We will complete deletion once the investigation is closed and will email confirmation.\"
legal-bot: retention-exception ticket created: RE-2026-3421 by ada. Linked vuln ticket: VULN-2026-128. Hold tags applied to 3 snapshot objects. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: Follow-up checklist I'll run tomorrow:
ops-oncall: - export list of snapshot object keys containing user artifacts
ops-oncall: - ensure old-key credentials are sealed in vault until rewrap is approved
ops-oncall: - only schedule rewrap after legal clearance; otherwise keep Hold tag
mike: I'll draft a small RBAC change PR: limit kms:ReEncrypt and s3:GetObject for backup keys to backup-operator+legal-priv via approval workflow in console. Will link PR to RE-2026-3421.
ada: Action items: sasha - attach DSAR verification docs to RE-2026-3421; ops-oncall - proceed with live redaction plan and apply hold tags; mike - prepare RBAC PR and audit-rule change.
sasha: On it. Posting verification evidence to the ticket and will ping when attached. Thanks :thumbsup:
